item.description:
Hi everyone!
I'm looking to put together a complete collection of Billie Piper's music videos from her music career (1998–2000), preferably from the highest-quality original sources available.
I'm particularly interested in the following:
Because We Want To
Girlfriend
She Wants You
Honey to the Bee
Last Christmas
Thank ABBA for the Music (Billie and other artists)
Day & Night
Something Deep Inside
Walk of Life
Preferred formats:
Original production masters / ProRes
DigiBeta or other professional tape transfers
DVD / VOB (PAL preferred)
High-quality broadcast recordings
Other unprocessed, high-quality sources
I'm also interested in any alternate versions, promotional edits or international music video variations that may exist.
Ideally, I'd prefer original, unaltered sources rather than AI-upscaled or heavily processed versions, as I'm interested in preserving the original picture quality.
If anyone has any of these videos, even just one or two, I'd be extremely grateful!
Many thanks!
